desc:
BATCHABLES CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIE MIX: Make small batches of chocolate chip cookies with Betty Crocker Batchables Chocolate Chip Cookie Mix

CHOOSE THE AMOUNT: You can make anywhere from four to 24 cookies per batch, or make the entire package for 28 cookies

ADD MILK OR WATER: You can whip up delicious cookie mix in no time by simply adding milk or water

PERFECT FOR SNACKING: Bake up a small batch of cookies for a yummy afternoon snack with none leftover; Try other Betty Crocker Batchables for easy desserts, including fudge brownies and blueberry muffins

CONTAINS: 28 oz
features:
Features:

Flexible Batch Sizes

Lets you bake 4, 8, 12, or up to 24 cookies at a time—great for reducing waste and customizing portions.

28 oz Resealable Tub

Comes in a large, resealable container to maintain freshness between uses.

Simple Prep

Just add milk (or water) and butter—no eggs required.

Rich in Chocolate Chips

Loaded with semi-sweet chocolate chips for a classic, indulgent cookie taste.

Supports Education Programs

Part of the Box Tops for Education initiative.

Trusted Brand

Backed by Betty Crocker’s long-standing reputation for quality baking mixes.

Benefits:

Convenient and Quick

Ideal for busy schedules—cookies are ready to bake in minutes with minimal effort.

Bake What You Need

Avoid food waste by baking only the amount you want, whether it's a few cookies or a full batch.

Kid- and Beginner-Friendly

Simple steps make it perfect for kids, beginners, or anyone looking for an easy baking experience.

Freshly Baked Taste Anytime

Enjoy warm, gooey chocolate chip cookies straight from your oven without a full baking session.

Great for All Occasions

Perfect for snacks, lunchboxes, parties, or quick dessert cravings.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Brown Sugar, Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Sugar, Palm Oil, Wheat Protein Isolate, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate), Salt.
